# Good Vibes Café

> A Nordic collective of builders, strategists and connectors. Shoot first, fail spectacularly, ship solid.

Good Vibes Café (formerly BizVibe) is a high-trust community for vibecoders: founders and builders who move fast, think in systems, and use AI as a co-founder. Membership is tiered (Starter, Viber, Vibetor), with events, a forum, a showcase of member work, badges, and certificates.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the collective.
- [About](/about): Founders, mission, and values.
- [Community](/community): What membership unlocks.
- [Showcase](/showcase): Member projects and case studies.
- [Forum](/forum): Discussions, leads, and the vault.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming meetups and online sessions.
- [Members](/members): Public member directory and leaderboard.
- [Badges](/badges): Recognition for community contributions.
- [Get Going](/get-going): How to start.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the founders.

## Membership

- [Apply Starter](/apply-starter): Free entry tier.
- [Apply Viber](/apply-viber): Paid membership with full access.
- [Apply Vibetor](/apply-vibetor): Invite-only investor and connector tier.
